name: FUN_PARALLEL_SETUP_PHASES
description: This table contains details of each phase of a parallel run.

columns.name: PARALLEL_PHASE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the parallel phase.

columns.name: PARALLEL_SETUP_ID
columns.description: Parallel setup that contains this phase.

columns.name: PHASE_ORDER_NUM
columns.description: Indicates the logical order of the phases. An older phases can only create data for later phases.

columns.name: PHASE_CODE
columns.description: Internal name of the phase. Its value must be unique within the parallel job.

columns.name: HAS_CHUNKING_ATTRIBUTE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a chunking attribute is provided. This attribute is for future use only. It is not currently supported.

columns.name: DATA_RETRIEVAL_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method used to retrieve the initial data for this phase. Possible values are NONE, SQL, and GT_TABLE. A value of NONE means that this phase does not have any initial data, and only processes data produced by upstream phases.

columns.name: GENDATA_RETRIEVAL_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method used to retrieve the data produced for downstream phases as a result of processing data in this phase. Possible values are NONE, SQL, and GT_TABLE. A value of NONE means that this phase does not produce data for a downstream phase.

columns.name: HAS_PRIORITIES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether priority information is provided for the phase data.

columns.name: HIGHEST_PRIORITY
columns.description: Indicates the priority order with which data is processed. of the job. Data with priority value of 1 is processed before data with priority value of 2, and so on.

columns.name: PROCESS_PRIORITIES_IN_ORDER
columns.description: Indicates whether all data for a higher priority must be processed completely before any data for a lower priority can be processed. If set as Y, idle threads will not start processing lower priority data while other threads are still processing higher priority data.

columns.name: CHUNK_ACROSS_PRIORITIES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a single chunk can contain data with multiple different priorities.

columns.name: HAS_SPLIT_COLUMN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether split column information is provided for the phase data.

columns.name: SPLIT_VALUE_CONCURRENCY_MODE
columns.description: Concurrency mode for split values. It determines whether split values are processed simultaneously. Possible values are NO_LIMIT, SINGLE, ONE_WITHIN, or ONE_ACROSS.

columns.name: GROUPING_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method used to group related data into the same chunk. Possible values are NONE, SIMPLE, and ADVANCED.

columns.name: GROUP_ACROSS_ORIGINAL_SQL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether grouping is done across all of the SQL statements in the initial fetch, when the initial fetch is done using SQL.

columns.name: GROUP_ACROSS_PRIOR_CHUNKS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether grouping is done across all of the data provided from prior phases for this phase, even if the data is coming from different prior phase chunks, different prior phase SQLs, or different phases.

columns.name: GROUP_ACROSS_BOTH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether grouping is done across both data from the initial fetch and data provided from prior phases for this phase.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ADVANCED_COLUMNS
columns.description: Number of advanced chunking columns.

columns.name: CHUNK_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Mode for creating chunks. Possible values are NORMAL, ONLY_ONE, and MAX_SIZED.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_CHUNK_SIZE
columns.description: Maximum size limit for creating chunks. This limit is ignored if larger chunks are required to satisfy the grouping and other settings.

columns.name: MINIMUM_CHUNK_SIZE
columns.description: Minimum size limit for creating chunks. This limit is ignored if smaller chunks are required to satisfy the data processing and other settings.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FLATTEN_ADVANCED_COLUMNS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether grouping is done across all advanced columns treating them as common attribute.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
